# Where each thesis figure comes from

One row per figure, in thesis order. Checked on 2026-09-30.

## Figures generated by a script

| Figure | File in the thesis | Script | Script version | Inputs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2.3 Label distributions under the seven noise conditions | `F1_noise_conditions.png` | `qsar_qm_models/scripts/figlib_figures.py`, function `f1_noise_conditions` | commit 028b7bc (29 Sep); file copied from `qsar_qm_models/results/decisions_arc/f/figures/` (29 Sep 23:01) | 2,000 synthetic labels drawn inside the script |
| 3.2 ANOVA decomposition | `fig2_anova_decomposition.png` | `qsar_qm_models/scripts/generate_paper_figures.py` | files written 24 Jun 00:03; script committed 4 min later as b92313d | QM9 results in `qsar_qm_models/results/`, assay results passed with `--validation-dir` |
| 3.3 Model–representation interaction | `fig_interaction.png` | same | same | same |
| 3.4 Noise robustness on PDV | `fig1_global_overview.png` | same | same | same |
| 3.5 Neural network families and random forests | `fig_nn_family_comparison.png` | same | file written 28 Jun; the last change before that is b92313d | same |
| 3.6 NDS on the three assay datasets | `fig_validation_overview.png` | same | 24 Jun, b92313d | same |
| 3.7 NDS on QM9 and the assay datasets | `fig_validation_combined.png` | same | 24 Jun, b92313d | same |
| 3.8 Mean predicted uncertainty | `fig_uncertainty_combined.png` | same | 24 Jun, b92313d | same |
| 4.1 Constant, near-constant and varying features | `figures_code_input/constant_features.pdf` | `constant_features/make_outputs.py` (also writes Tables 4.1 and 4.2) | copy in this folder | `constant_features/constant_counts.json`, from `constant_features/count_constant.py` |
| 4.2 Two hERG $K_i$ stereoisomers with identical ECFP4 vectors | `figures_code_input/herg_ki_ecfp4_stereo_pair.pdf` | `stereo_pair/figure.py` | copy in this folder | `stereo_pair/ties_results.json`, from `stereo_pair/ties.py`; the saved ECFP4 matrix `/Volumes/seagate/kirby_cache/rep_cache/herg_ki/ecfp4.npy` |
| 4.3 Absolute p$K_i$ difference against pair distance | `figures_code_input/herg_ki_pair_distance_vs_dpki.pdf` | `herg_pairs/figure.py` | copy in this folder | `herg_pairs/herg_ki_pair_*.npy`, from `herg_pairs/compute.py` |

- The Chapter 3 PNGs used by the thesis are byte-identical to `qsar_qm_models/results/paper_figures/` (checked by MD5).
- The committed `generate_paper_figures.py` has changed since June, in commits 3286e82 and 1bcd308. Rerunning the current version may not reproduce these files exactly. Check out b92313d to reproduce them.
- The Chapter 4 scripts were written by an earlier Claude session on 29 Sep. The originals are in `KIRBy/scratchpad/thesis_code_todo/{constant,ties,distance}/`, and their paths point there.
  - They read only saved feature files and `meta_<dataset>.npz`. They build no representation.
  - The `meta_<dataset>.npz` files come from `scratchpad/thesis_code_todo/extract_meta.py`.
- Figure 4.2 is the pair of hERG $K_i$ molecules with identical ECFP4 vectors that has the largest p$K_i$ difference. `stereo_pair/figure.py` chooses it, and it records the chosen pair in `stereo_pair/figure_pair.json`.
